items.question: What percentage service fee does this retailer add to the pre-discounted basket value for UAE orders?
items.gold: A 5% fee is added to the pre-discounted basket value.
items.fact: UAE service fee is 5% of pre-discounted basket value.

items.question: If an order receives a full refund, is the small order fee refunded?
items.gold: Yes, in case of a full refund the small order fee is refunded.
items.fact: Small order fee is refunded on full refunds, not partial.
